name: On Guard in Stonetalon
summary: At a camp near Windshear Crag, Kaela Shadowspear sends Alliance travelers to Gaxim Rustfizzle for help against the Venture Company. The cautious night elf sentinel and eccentric gnome tinkerer join forces to guard the mountain pass from the company's rampant despoilment.

sections.title: An Unlikely Alliance
sections.body: In the crags of Stonetalon Mountains, the rapacious Venture Company cuts into wilderness and fells ancient trees. Kaela Shadowspear, a night elf sentinel, sees that martial skill alone cannot stop its industrialized pillaging. She turns to gnome ingenuity, though night elves and gnomes rarely agree on technology or the natural world. Their unlikely alliance shows how precarious the struggle has become.

sections.title: Gnomish Philosophy
sections.body: Gaxim Rustfizzle brings the eccentric pragmatism of the Alliance's smaller allies. Night elf society turned away from arcane excess millennia ago, but Gaxim believes that abstaining from magic and technical innovation leaves the night elves vulnerable. He hopes to convince his Kaldorei hosts that practical science can defend nature as well as bow and glaive.

faq.q: Why are a night elf and a gnome working together here?
faq.answer: The Venture Company's deforestation and resource extraction in Stonetalon have become so severe that Kaela Shadowspear accepts outside aid. Gaxim brings engineering and alchemical expertise the night elves typically lack, offering technical support against modern industrial machinery.

Gaxim Rustfizzle is an adventurous gnome engineer and tinkerer at a camp near Windshear Crag. He believes abstaining from arcane magic leaves night elves at a disadvantage, and seeks to prove that engineering, alchemy, and controlled magic together can answer dire threats.
Kaela Shadowspear is a night elf sentinel charged with watch and defense over the Stonetalon Mountains. As a regional commander, she coordinates resistance against the Venture Company.

faq.q: What threat is the Venture Company posing in Stonetalon?
faq.answer: The Venture Company is an unscrupulous mercantile syndicate cutting sacred forests, running destructive drilling rigs, and polluting Stonetalon's pristine lands for rapid commercial profit.

faq.q: Who is Tara, mentioned by Kaela?
faq.answer: Tara is Sentinel Tara Thenysil, Kaela's friend in Astranaar, who sent you to check on her. Kaela is proud that Tara is doing well enough among the Sentinels to send adventurers on errands.

faq.q: Where does this task lead next?
aliases: quest after on guard in stonetalon
faq.answer: After you speak with Gaxim Rustfizzle, he offers 'A Gnome's Respite' and asks for your aid holding back the Venture Company's loggers in Windshear Crag while he plans his next inventions.

angles.text: As a gnome, you can see Gaxim Rustfizzle put gnomish ingenuity to work in Kalimdor, where science, engineering, and magic can meet the region's challenges.
As a night elf, you may feel pride give way when Kaldorei sentinels trust a gnome tinkerer who favors engineering and magic. The Venture Company's logging has become devastating.
As an engineer, you can see how engineering helps with frontline reconnaissance and ecosystem defense. Cogwheels can aid conservation when turned against unchecked exploitation.
As an Alliance member, you see Eastern Kingdoms expertise join Kalimdor sentinels against threats shared across the frontier.
